classification_definitions.canonical_candidate: A strong candidate to own this semantic layer after a separately reviewed migration.
classification_definitions.reusable_input: Reviewed evidence or structure that Semantic IR can reference without changing it.
classification_definitions.compatibility_adapter: A boundary that translates existing representations for a consumer.
classification_definitions.historical_generator: A milestone-specific generator retained for reproducibility, not selected as the future source of truth.
classification_definitions.duplicate_representation: Derived semantic content also encoded elsewhere and therefore exposed to drift.
classification_definitions.superseded_representation: An older artifact retained for history after a corrected representation replaced it.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Ownership or canonical status requires a future product decision.
